text.card: A red giant 4,251 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 2.38 solar masses and 15.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,022 K at its surface.
